task.description:

- GET /instances/:id/history returns all events in ascending sequence order
- Optional filters: event_type, from, to (ISO 8601 timestamps)

- Any authenticated role may access
- Archived events (ES-07) included in correct sequence position

3. zig build test exits 0
4. No regressions in existing tests

- Set API-05 status to "RELEASED"
- Set released_at to current timestamp
- Set release_run to "WF02-api05-20260523"

Write release decision to docs/status/release-API-05-20260523.json
